## What's new

### Fixes
- **Tiles that share a number now show as they do in game** ([#5](https://github.com/RoofooEvazan/ds1-studio/issues/5)). When two DT1s have the same tile number and no random variants, the game always uses the one in the DT1 loaded first (the lowest LvlTypes File slot). DS1 Studio used to show the later one. In PD2's Djinn's Domain that was 2,328 cells of the palace floor drawn as desert sand. Tiles with random variants are still picked among all of them, as the game does.

### DT1 editor
- **Clone** ([#3](https://github.com/RoofooEvazan/ds1-studio/issues/3)) copies the selected tiles into the DT1 under a new, unused sub index, keeping the originals. Tick **same number** to make them random variants of the originals instead.
- **Mirror** flips the selected tiles left to right. Pixels and walkability flags flip, and walls turn to face the other way (left ↔ right, as WinDS1 pairs them: 1↔2, 3↔4, 6↔7, 8↔9, 10↔11, 16↔17). Both halves of a north-corner wall go together. Clone first to keep both versions.
- **Export PNG… / Import PNG…** ([#4](https://github.com/RoofooEvazan/ds1-studio/issues/4)): save a tile as an indexed PNG in the palette shown, edit it in GIMP or similar, and import it back. Import keeps the indices of an indexed PNG and matches other colours to the palette (Act 0 colours in Act 0 mode). Walls take any shape within their area; floors and roofs keep their diamond.

### Tidier files
- **One file per level type for DS1 Studio's own tiles.** Automap edits, walkability blockers and copies, floor rerolls and pasted preset tiles used to make a new DT1 each time (`studio/amun…` and `<map>_walk.dt1`). They now all go into one file per level type, in the folder its other libraries live in, for example `Guilds/guild_custom.dt1`. It costs the level type one File slot, however many maps and edits there are. Tile numbers are picked free across the whole level type, so maps sharing the file never see each other's tiles.
- New water and custom DT1s default to that folder too. Preset source tiles go to `presets/`.
- **Export → Level type package…** packs a whole level type as one zip for a mod's developers:
  - every tile library once;
  - one file per table (Levels, LvlPrest, LvlTypes, AutoMap, map items) with the rows of all its maps;
  - the strings, and optionally the maps.
  
  **Gather into one folder** first copies the type's libraries into one folder under readable names and points the level type at them, slot for slot. No map, Dt1Mask or AutoMap row changes.
- The Compatibility check now explains when same-numbered tiles show at random and when the first-loaded DT1 wins.
